title: 1942 FBI file: Laurel Canyon address, Norfolk, compromat
place_text: Laurel Canyon, Los Angeles; Norfolk, Virginia

tellings.quote: A clue might be found in a 1942 FBI file on Brown. The file shows Brown living in Laurel Canyon on Wonderland Boulevard.

plain: A 1942 file kept by the FBI, the US federal police, on the inventor Townsend Brown shows him living in Laurel Canyon in Los Angeles, on Wonderland Boulevard, and Michels says it may hold a clue to his secret life, with threads leading to Norfolk, Virginia, and to compromising material that could be used for blackmail. Michels tells this himself in his documentary on Brown, whom he calls a CIA scientist who built UFOs, drawing on Brown's biographer Paul Schatzkin and the physicist Paul LaViolette.
